finding.title: Run returns before in-flight deliveries finish
finding.explanation: Run returns as soon as ctx is cancelled, without closing d.jobs or waiting for the workers. cmd/worker exits when Run returns, so a delivery in flight at SIGTERM is cut off mid-request. It is never marked delivered, so the receiver gets it again after the restart. The workers also pass the cancelled ctx to deliver, which aborts the HTTP call immediately.
finding.reasoningSummary: Nothing in Run joins the goroutines it starts. cmd/worker/main.go calls os.Exit(0) right after dispatcher.Run returns. deliver() marks a job done only after the receiver answers 2xx.
finding.suggestedFix: Track the workers with a sync.WaitGroup, close d.jobs once ctx is done, and wait before returning. Give in-flight deliveries a context that survives the cancellation (context.WithoutCancel plus a timeout) so they can finish.

evidence.text: read_file cmd/worker/main.go:40-58: os.Exit(0) runs immediately after dispatcher.Run returns
